title: Bound retained scratch history for the actual encoded prefix planner
body:
The actual PR5707 minimum-prefix planner clears Count symbols without shrinking physical tape backing. Its 14-lease bound therefore does not by itself bound retained storage over repeated calls. This package proves a per-physical-tape history envelope from the full reached Count primitive ledger, including returned q/depth/stock and arbitrary erased warm tails.

For b=bitlength(M), k=bitlength(K), c=ceil(log2 F), h=m−1, every newly written extent is at most E=max(7,b+k+1,chb+2)+2. Each retained tape is bounded by max(initial extent, all prior E). This gives a linear digit bound for the standalone 32-tape planner with fixed construction constants. It does not bound the enclosing 256-tape RootPlan history, Python heap allocation, tape actions or complete multiplier obligations.

Source: Ali Romman's PR5707 at `8a3ed4641ed4efd5c0eef70c94dbfc48f95d8cd1`, with PR5688 and Jose Manuel's physical controller attribution retained. The source archive, planner and selected frontier are unchanged. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19234413.

Validation: registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replay passes; each runs 14 actual-source calls and checks every pool write, arithmetic outputs, borrowed state, returned leases and erased retained tails. Cold and warm histories each execute 6,014 observed pool writes with peak 14 live leases. Negative controls expose last-call-only accounting (26 retained cells versus a final-call bound of 9), omitted warm backing, and omitted output cleanup. Committed-byte/source-history checks, official export integrity, read-only Git-free optimized replay, and exported source-hash mutation rejection pass.

The all-size result is a written source-bound proof with finite corroboration, not formal or independent human proof acceptance. Open next questions cover the complete RootPlan ledger, independent proof review, and movement/precision integration. No full selected/payload replay, Lean, Docker, dependency installation, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

Produced by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
